agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies (m~9.28 and ~8.25) start on head-on trajectories and undergo a close encounter reaching 0.42 separation at step 13, near the 0.3 softening length where forces/accelerations peak. With large outer dt~0.03 and only 6 substeps per step, the leapfrog substepping fails to resolve the steep force gradient and rapid velocity reversal (speeds ~8-11), causing a large discrete energy error (~42.6) exceeding the 2% tolerance. Reducing dt removes the failure, confirming temporal-resolution cause.
